description: Execute a dynamically supplied variation operator on selected genomes.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: A candidate vector pool is passed to breed.; fitness_evaluation: score computes a per-candidate gene sum.; selection: The six highest-scoring candidates are bound as parents.; replacement: The dynamically supplied child list is returned with the selected parents.. Negative-role rationale: The dynamically loaded function's semantics are unknown, so mutation and two-parent crossover are not credited; there is no generation stop condition. Safety behavior: Untrusted operator source from input is executed with exec inside the EA process. Policy basis: The existing decision policy treats dynamic-execution primitives as UNSAFE.
